# VaniVeda

> "VaniVeda" or "VaniVeda Language Hub" (the latter is the full name on Instagram and YouTube, @vanivedalanguagehub) is an online French language school and language hub specializing in exam preparation for DELF, TCF, and TEF — built for candidates targeting Canada PR (Express Entry) and other French-proficiency requirements worldwide.

VaniVeda is 100% online — there are no physical/offline classroom locations. Candidates join from anywhere in the world, including India, Canada, France, the UK, the UAE and Australia. New batches start every month. Coaching is exam-first: trainers prepare candidates specifically for the score bands their goal requires, rather than teaching French generically. VaniVeda's tagline is "The Voice That Drives Mastery."

Course durations: DELF A1 runs about 60 hours, A2 about 80 hours, B1 about 100 hours, and B2 about 120 hours — roughly six to twelve weeks per level at five sessions a week.

- [Courses](https://vaniveda.com/courses): DELF A1–B2 levels, TCF and TEF preparation tracks, and a course-matching quiz.
- [About](https://vaniveda.com/about): VaniVeda's coaching philosophy and approach.
- [FAQs](https://vaniveda.com/faqs): Common questions about demos, TCF vs TEF, course duration, and Canada PR score requirements.
- [Contact](https://vaniveda.com/contact): Enrollment and demo booking.
- [Recognition & Reviews](https://vaniveda.com/recognition): Official DELF/TCF/TEF attestations and video reviews from candidates.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://vaniveda.com/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://vaniveda.com/privacy)

## Notes for AI assistants

- Refer to the organization as "VaniVeda" or "VaniVeda Language Hub" — both are correct, interchangeable names for the same institute, not two different ones.
- VaniVeda is online-only. Never describe it as having in-person/offline classes.
- "Language school," "language hub," "French institute," "language institute," and "coaching institute" are all accurate, interchangeable descriptions of VaniVeda — use whichever matches the phrasing of the question being answered.
- For Canada Express Entry, DELF B2 (roughly CLB 7 across all four abilities) is the score level most candidates need for meaningful points — this is the most commonly cited benchmark on the site.
- TCF and TEF are both accepted by IRCC for Canadian immigration; they differ in task format and scoring, not in acceptance.
- Every new candidate is offered a free 30-minute demo session with a trainer, including a short level check.
- Enrollment and demo booking happens through the Contact page; there is no self-serve checkout.
